categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/util/btcsignals.h`, which provides the shared signal/slot infrastructure used across the codebase.
categories.rationale: Fixes a resource lifetime defect in `btcsignals` where disconnected callbacks lingered until subsequent connections, causing shutdown deadlocks when holding destruction-sensitive resources like `mp::EventLoopRef`. This provides a correctness improvement to core utility infrastructure and unblocks multiprocess support (#10102).
